fields.statement: Runs heal themselves: a PR that conflicts after main moves is rebased by its own run, a flaky CI check is rerun once before a run fails, a daemon start that never journaled is retried without a restart, the daemon picks up a rebuilt binary by itself, and a session stuck with no activity shows as stalled

fields.quote: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.
fields.statement: Milestone 10 is five change sets picked by the orchestrator from the hand fixes it still made on unattended runs: conflicting PRs settled in the wait, one CI rerun, the unjournaled block expiring, the daemon re-executing a rebuilt binary, and stalled sessions surfaced

ship check --settled reads the PR's mergeable state; on CONFLICTING it runs the ship rebase logic (which returns early when the branch already holds origin/main, so the later rebase steps stay harmless), settling rendered-only conflicts and recording the pushed head, then reports not settled; on a code conflict it raises the rebase-conflict question and exits 75 with a stop: line; wait steps learn to stop on 75 as command steps do; --settled may now write the ship record
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: When a PR or main check fails, ship check reruns that GitHub Actions run's failed jobs once per head (run id from the check's detailsUrl, or databaseId for --main), records the rerun in the ship record and keeps waiting; a second failure on the same head fails as today; checks with no Actions run id are not rerun
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: An unjournaled change set is held for a fixed 15 minutes (daemonUnjournaledRetry) and then picked again, re-entering the one-minute pending grace; a change set that has landed or been withdrawn leaves the unjournaled map at once; the pending grace that prevents double starts is unchanged
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: At the end of a poll with nothing pending, the daemon compares its executable's size and modification time with those at startup and, if they changed, re-executes itself with the same arguments; live runs are separate processes and are untouched; the daemon records its version in its state, and daemon status prints it
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A live run's session whose resolved hook status is working with a last report older than 20 minutes is stalled, except when paused for a usage limit; run status marks it stalled and the inbox lists it as a stalled item naming the session and its run; blocked and idle sessions are never stalled
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)
